# ChillZone

> ChillZone (UK Charity 1214818) creates a safe, welcoming and empowering space for young people in the Jewish community — therapeutic support, workshops and friendship.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mission, what we do, and how to get involved.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from ChillZone events, workshops and activities.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, phone and WhatsApp contact details.
- [Donate](/donate): Donate via Charity Extra or Achisomoch.
